findings.evidence: Five near-identical congrArg/symm_apply_apply terms in the diff; hf, the toFun body and the section variable restate the same lambda.
findings.fix: Define the fibre-by-fibre map once, e.g. `ManifoldTotalSpace.fiberwiseMap (φ : ∀ b, P b → Q b)`, with a @[simp] lemma `fiberwiseMap φ (homeomorph p) = homeomorph ⟨p.proj, φ _ p.2⟩`. Then derive left_inv/right_inv/hfs and the two simp lemmas from it by `simp`.
findings.issue: The `congrArg (fun p ↦ homeomorph _ ⟨p.proj, φ p.2⟩) ((homeomorph _).symm_apply_apply _)` argument is repeated in hfs (l.87-92), left_inv (l.132-137), right_inv (l.139-144), diffeomorphOfEquivariant_apply (l.158-161) and diffeomorphOfEquivariant_symm_apply (l.166-169). The forward/inverse map expressions are copied 4 and 2 times. The `simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using (congrArg …).symm` in hfs only works because both sides unfold to the same term.

findings.evidence: mathlib Trivialization.lean:681 `variable [∀ x, Nonempty (E x)]` precedes `Trivialization.symm`; grep shows no existing such lemma in TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/FiberBundle.
findings.fix: Move both into Principal.lean (e.g. a Nonempty instance/lemma and `contMDiffAt_trivializationAt_symm_one`) and cite them here.
findings.issue: Two facts that do not depend on `e` are proved inside the main proof: nonemptiness of principal-bundle fibres (needed for `Trivialization.symm`) and `C^n` smoothness at b₀ of the local section `b ↦ (trivializationAt G P b₀).symm b 1` (hσ, l.69-80). The roadmap's B1.2/B1.3 consumers will need the same local-section smoothness.

findings.evidence: Principal.lean:208 `contMDiffOn_id.congr fun x _ ↦ by rw [TotalSpace.eta, Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply, id_eq]`.
findings.fix: Use `contMDiffAt_id.congr_of_eventuallyEq (.of_forall fun y ↦ by rw [TotalSpace.eta, Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply, id_eq])`, matching Principal.lean:208.
findings.issue: hq uses `convert … using 1; funext; exact apply_symm_apply` for an identity-map fact; the neighbouring file already has a direct idiom for this.

summary: The same symm_apply_apply/congrArg identity is proved by hand five times because the forward and inverse maps are never named, and general local-section facts are proved inline instead of as reusable lemmas.
